headline: Festive Timing Clouds the Print

highlights: Adjusted for this, SSSG stood at ~11% (V-Mart: 10%; Unlimited: 12%), marking the 12th consecutive quarter of positive growth.

The festive shift is expected to benefit 3QFY27, suggesting the softer reported growth does not reflect underlying demand weakness.  Footfall growth yet to translate into commensurate conversions: Footfall increased 36% YoY, significantly ahead of 15% growth in transaction volumes, while apparel ASP remained flat.

The management indicated ~35% as a more appropriate conversion benchmark, highlighting scope for improvement in converting higher store traffic into sales.  Unlimited outperforms core V-Mart on profitability: Unlimited's EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% in 2QFY27, ahead of core V-Mart's 8.8%, supported by lower rental costs and improving store productivity.
Outlook: V-Mart added 23 stores and closed one, taking its network to 613 stores across 351 cities, while retaining its FY27 guidance of 90–100 store openings.
valuation: YTD sales per sq. ft. increased 15% to Rs681, reinforcing Unlimited's growing contribution to overall profitability.  We maintain BUY with a revised TP of Rs860 (from Rs830 earlier) and roll forward valuation at 40x Sept’28E EPS.
Valuation: We trim FY27E and FY28E EBITDA by about 2% each and PAT by about 8% and 1.5%.
We maintain BUY with a revised TP of Rs860 and roll forward valuation at 40x Sept’28E EPS.
watch: Outlook: V-Mart added 23 stores and closed one, taking its network to 613 stores across 351 cities, while retaining its FY27 guidance of 90–100 store openings.
H2 recovery hinges on the festive demand shift and planned 5–6% price hikes, although below-target festive trading, crude-linked cost pressures and intensifying competition remain key concerns.
